hints: Watch the pressure gauge as the plunger goes in. Does the number stay put?

The same particles in less space hit each bit of wall more often. Boyle's law, the rule for squeezing a gas at a fixed temperature, says P₁V₁ = P₂V₂. So half the volume means double the pressure. You can feel this in a bike pump. Block the end and push, and the air pushes back harder.
Squeeze it to 20 mL, a third of the start. Has the pressure gone up about three times?
